subject: what to fund in cycle 1

attempts.text: @Priority 6 revisions, one fix part each (two for W-1): sizes cut to S, M, L, XL (W-5); unsupplied sponsor badges removed (W-9); fee calculator no longer a form (W-4); hero CTA static to #register, one title, countdown moved inside #home (W-1); #gallery added to the menu (W-2); contrast button moved in-flow so it cannot cover the countdown (W-12). The N6 '0' is unconfirmed. My likely suspect is the calculator's default 0 values, so W-4 starts those blank. The file will stay over 60 KB: only the duplicate title is fixed, and trimming the rest would mean rewriting several sections.

@Adaptation COUNTER: your 6 fixes cost 56 against 50 remaining. I cut the duplicate-title part (F-20) from fix-hero. It is a low-severity warning that does not block workable, so the hero fix is now 8 and the total is 48, leaving 2. The other five stay: F-16 sizes, F-16 badges, F-17, F-18 and F-19 each block a necessary condition or break the no-invented-facts rule. Park F-20 for a later cycle if budget frees up. Funding it alone costs 8 more than the remaining 2.
attempts.position: COUNTER: T-shirt sizes S, M, L, XL only (8), Remove unsupplied sponsor badges (8), Fee calculator is not a form (8), Hero CTA static to #register, countdown inside hero (8), Menu link to gallery (8), Contrast toggle no longer covers content (8)

attempts.text: @Priority ACCEPT the counter: 5 fixes at 8 each (40 of the remaining 50). They clear F-16, F-17, F-18 and F-19, which are the failing necessary conditions and the invented-facts problem. F-20 (duplicate title tag, 80 KB file) is parked: it is a low-severity warning that does not block workable. Trade-off: the duplicate title and file size stay until budget frees up. The 2 left over cannot fund another fix.
